name: McCarty v. McCarty
summary: The Supreme Court held that federal law preempted California's community property law insofar as it sought to divide military retirement pay as a marital asset, finding that the federal scheme governing military retirement was incompatible with state division rules.
significance: This earlier decision addressed federal preemption of state community property laws as applied to military retirement pay, establishing that federal law can displace state law in the context of dividing federal benefit assets in divorce.
